summary: The changed service now rejects callers that omit prepared-mutation authorization, and the added tests cover REST admission, usage and credit consumption, expiry, revocation, and limit refusal. No introduced defect was found in the changed paths.

evidence: At the base commit, `extensionExecutionContext` in main.ts already filters bound connections on `!connection.revokedAt` and `Date.parse(connection.expiresAt) > selectedAt`, so expired and revoked connections are refused before execution row creation.
At the base commit, `extensionExecutionContext` already supplies `authorizePrepared`, which calls `connectionStore.authorizeBinding` with `consume: true`, enforcing both usage and credit limits.

All three REST extension-operation routes already spread `executionContext.authorization` into `startExtensionOperation` at the base commit, so the candidate adds a required-callback guard and tests rather than new route wiring or expiry filtering.
